drawing_or_document_ref: Approved Structural Shop Drawings / Bar Bending Schedule Spreadsheets
issuing_authority_or_counterpart: EPC Contractor (M/s Badri Rai & Co.) / Approved Rebar Fabricator / RITES Supervising Engineer
exact_information_needed: Comprehensive member-by-member bar bending schedules per IS 2502 / IS 13920:2016 detailing bar mark, bar diameter, shape code, cut lengths, bend deductions, hook dimensions, lap splice locations/staggering, and calculated weight for all structural elements: Columns C1-C3, Shear Walls SW1-SW10, Plinth Beams PB1-PB34, Typical Beams B1-B34, Terrace Beams TB1-TB34, Floor Slabs S1-S2, Stairs, Mumty, and OHT.
blocked_parameters_and_elements: All reinforcement steel tonnages across tower: Columns (52.41 MT), Shear walls (30.12 MT), Beams (53.76 MT), Slabs (36.69 MT), Piles (99.24 MT), Caps (20.35 MT), Total 300.85 MT; and all rebar bending/fixing labour mandays.

unblocking_potential: Converts 300.85 MT of estimated steel into deterministic, shop-verifiable quantities; unblocks steel trade validation and bar-bending labour productivity modeling.

issuing_authority_or_counterpart: EPC Contractor (M/s Badri Rai & Co.) / EPC Design Consultant / RITES NERPO
exact_information_needed: Member-by-member schedules detailing: individual clear spans of all 108 beam segments per floor (PB1-PB34, B1-B34, TB1-TB34) excluding column and shear wall head nodes (49 vertical elements); actual web and flange dimensions; panel-by-panel slab schedule detailing net clear panel boundaries excluding 230mm beam web ribs; and floor-by-floor structural variation notes.
blocked_parameters_and_elements: Plinth beam concrete (47.61 m3), Floor beam concrete (289.80 m3), Terrace beam concrete (48.30 m3), Suspended floor slabs concrete (331.47 m3), Terrace slab concrete (55.24 m3), and formwork shuttering surface areas.
risk_and_impact_if_unresolved: Gross grid run length (403.5m) and uniform 130mm slab thickness double-count concrete at beam-column joint intersections and slab-beam monoliths, inflating structural frame concrete by 8% to 12%; floor cycle times cannot be scheduled accurately.
